title: 28 February 1961: Live: Cassanova Club, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ fifth performance at the Cassanova Club, promoted by Sam R Leach. The date was rescheduled from 18 February, when The Beatles had originally been booked to perform.

The Cassanova Club was situated above Sampson & Barlow’s Restaurant at 39 London Road, Liverpool. The club was previously sited in The Temple, Dale Street, Liverpool, but moved to this location on 9 February 1961.

The Beatles played at the Cassanova Club on seven occasions. The other dates were 11, 14, 16 and 21 February, and 7 and 12 March 1961.

The Beatles had performed at the Cassanova on the date of the original venue’s opening (date unknown), but Ray McFall, owner of the Cavern Club, told them they were not allowed to play at both venues. The restriction was later lifted, and The Beatles played many times at events promoted by Sam Leach.

After this show they gave another performance at Litherland Town Hall, Liverpool.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1972: US single release: Give Ireland Back To The Irish by Wings
  • 1970: Mixing: For You Blue
  • 1970: Mixing: Oo You by Paul McCartney
  • 1967: Recording: Lucy In The Sky With Diamonds
  • 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas
  • 1964: Radio: From Us To You
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Granada Cinema, Shrewsbury – Lennon and McCartney write From Me To You
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Litherland Town Hall, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
